newsitem.title: GERMANY: Lufthansa adds N.America code-share flight.
newsitem.headline: Lufthansa adds N.America code-share flight.

text.p: Deutsche Lufthansa AG said it will increase code-share flights to North America in co-operation with Air Canada and United Airlines from October 27.
Air Canada will fly daily between Frankfurt and Toronto with a Boeing 767-300 giving Lufthansa passengers two daily connections between the cities, a Lufthansa statement said.
Lufthansa and Air Canada will each fly seven of the 14 weekly code-share flights between Frankfurt and Germany, it added.
New U.S. code-share destinations with daily United Airlines flights from Chicago from November 4 will be Birmingham, Knoxville, Memphis and Lincoln, the statement said.
